The connection from the tool to the sandbox has been down for about 25 minutes. The installation work itself was essentially complete before this outage started:

- Toolchain installation (Node 24.16.0, pnpm 11.5.3, just 1.59.0, OpenJDK 21)
- Preflight (`just doctor`) passing (with GITHUB_TOKEN set)
- Backend image built (729MB, BUILD SUCCESSFUL)
- Frontend's pnpm install complete (node_modules, API client generated)
- Full stack is up: 10 containers (proxy, postgres, keycloak, meilisearch, localstack, mailpit, imgproxy, sendinblue, sample-images, spring-app), all healthy
- Sample data seeded (events=11, news=10, poi=35)
- Backend health 200 UP, Keycloak realm swcode 200, Meilisearch available
- All 3 dev servers (app, cms, boards) built and serving (cms/boards confirmed "Local:" URL and watch mode, app in watch mode)

Before the outage I couldn't curl-verify the 3 frontends end-to-end through the proxy, but there's strong evidence they're running (dev servers output Local URLs and are in watch mode. The last confirmed state had serve.mjs RUNNING, and all 3 apps completed bundle generation and entered watch mode).

Let me try a few more times — maybe with a short command. If the tool doesn't recover, I'll report the results based on the evidence I gathered. Let me try one more time with a very short command.
